! Game text
| If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table. Opponent's total Force generation is -1 (and your total power everywhere is +1) for each [Endor] or [Death Star II] battleground you occupy (limit 2). Once per turn, if a card was just stacked on I Feel The Conflict, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. May lose 2 Force to cancel You Are Beaten or an attempt to steal Luke's Lightsaber. During your move phase, may {{Errata hl|1=turn a card stacked on I Feel The Conflict face up to}} relocate Luke between a battleground site and your Death Star II site. || If He Is The Chosen One on table, deploy on table. {{Errata hl|1=Indeed You Are Powerful:}} Once per turn, if {{Errata hl|1=you just won}} a {{Errata hl|1=battle or duel}}, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and shuffle your Reserve Deck. {{Errata hl|1=I Have To Face Him: Once per game, during}} your move phase, may relocate Luke {{Errata hl|1=to same}} battleground {{Errata hl|1=as Prophecy Of The Force. Father, Please!: Non-[Set 13] Anakin Skywalker does not cause Force loss}} and{{Errata hl|1=, once per game, you may lose 1 Force to play it from outside}} your {{Errata hl|1=deck as if from hand}}.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern [[His Destiny]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
